description: Curated list of FCS (I-AA) playoff games in the committed CFBD cache (issue #379). CFBD files most of them as season_type 'regular' (the 2013 first round is regular week 14) and marks only part of each bracket in notes, so no field of the record says which games are playoff games. Each entry names one CFBD game id with the season, CFBD's season type, the home/away team names exactly as CFBD reports them, the bracket round and a provenance note. Ingest (cfb_strength/ingest/fcs_playoff_games.py) stores season_type='postseason' for exactly these ids, keeps week and raw_json as CFBD reports them, and raises unless each entry matches its record. The list was built from the notes markers plus FCS-vs-FCS games after each season's regular-season finale, and checked by bracket structure (tests/test_fcs_playoff_games_data.py); `seasons` records each season's bracket size and whether the cache holds all of it. Conference title games, the SWAC title game, the Celebration Bowl, the Gridiron Classic and Division II/III playoff games are not listed.
